'''''Star Wars: Doctor Aphra''''' is a ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, written by [[Alyssa Wong]] and art by [[Marika Cresta]], which takes place between the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which began publishing digitally on [[May 4]], [[2020]] and in print on [[May 27]], 2020. It focuses on the titular character [[Chelli Lona Aphra]].

The series was scheduled to begin publishing by [[Marvel Comics]] in [[April]] 2020,<ref name="Apr20Solicit">{{WebCite|url=https://www.newsarama.com/48729-marvel-comics-april-2020-solicitations.html|text=MARVEL COMICS April 2020 Solicitations|date=2020-01-23|work=Newsarama.com|archivedate=20200220164528}}</ref> but due to the [[Wikipedia:Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] [[Wikipedia:2019–20 coronavirus pandemic|pandemic]], all Marvel Comics publications ceased publication starting April 1, 2020.<ref name="Digital">{{WebCite|url=https://www.newsarama.com/49653-marvel-not-releasing-any-new-titles-this-week-print-or-digitally-but-may-change-in-future.html|text=MARVEL Not Releasing Any New Titles This Week Print or Digitally, But May Change in Future|date=2020-03-31|work=Newsarama.com|archivedate=20200331185910}}</ref> Eventually, Marvel Comics resumed their publishing line on [[May 27]], 2020 and included the [[Doctor Aphra (2020) 1|first issue]] of the series in its initial lineup,<ref name="Resume Publishing">{{WebCite|url=https://www.newsarama.com/50048-marvel-to-resume-new-comics-releases-may-27-announce-schedule-through-july-8.html|text=MARVEL To Resume New Comics Releases May 27, Announce Schedule Through July 8|date=2020-05-01|work=Newsarama.com|archivedate=20200519173904}}</ref> but the release was moved to [[May 4]] for a digital release.<ref name="Marvel" />

On [[November 27]], [[2023]], Wong revealed that the series was set to end with the release of the [[Doctor Aphra (2020) 40|fortieth]] issue<ref name="Alyssa tweet" /> on [[January 31]], [[2024]].<ref name="Issue 40" /> ''Doctor Aphra'' won the [[Wikipedia:35th GLAAD Media Awards|2024 GLAAD award]] for Outstanding Comic Book.<ref name="Wong GLAAD">{{Twitter|crashwong|status/1770135534943240411|[[Alyssa Wong]]|quote=WE WON A GLAAD!!!!!!! 🏳️‍🌈🏳️‍⚧️✨✨ DOCTOR APHRA won the GLAAD Media Award for Outstanding Comic Book this year!! So proud of our team and the stories we got to tell. Thank you so much for all of your support!!!}}</ref>
